name: Blockchain Networks & Interoperability
description: Knowledge of the major blockchain networks, virtual machine families, and the cross-chain interoperability protocols that connect them. Covers EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Fantom, Gnosis, Huobi ECO, Moonbeam/Moonriver), TVM-based chains (TON, Everscale, Gosh, Venom), Solana's unique architecture, Arbitrum as an L2, and general interoperability principles and bridges.

subskills.name: Interoperability
subskills.description: Protocols and standards enabling communication between distinct blockchains: cross-chain bridges (lock-and-mint, burn-and-mint), atomic swaps, inter-blockchain communication (IBC protocol — Cosmos), Polkadot's XCMP, LayerZero's omnichain messaging, Wormhole, Chainlink CCIP. Understanding bridge security risks (bridge exploits have caused billions in losses: Ronin, Wormhole, Nomad). Hash Time-Locked Contracts (HTLCs) for trustless swaps.

subskills.name: EVM-Based Chains
subskills.description: The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) specification and the ecosystem of EVM-compatible chains. Ethereum mainnet (gas, accounts, EIPs), Polygon (PoS sidechain and zkEVM), BNB Smart Chain (BSC, PoSA consensus, 21 validators), Gnosis Chain (xDAI, low-cost stable gas), Huobi ECO Chain (HECO), Avalanche C-Chain (Snowman consensus, sub-second finality), Fantom (Lachesis DAG-based aBFT), Moonbeam/Moonriver (Polkadot parachain EVM). Key developer implication: same Solidity code deploys across all, but gas costs, block times, finality, and bridge security differ.

subskills.name: TVM-Based Chains
subskills.description: Chains running the TON Virtual Machine (TVM) — a distinct VM architecture from EVM. TON (The Open Network — originally Telegram, now independent): actor model, sharding architecture, Fift/FunC/Tact languages for smart contracts, Jettons (TVM-native tokens). Everscale (formerly Free TON): TVM with DeBot browser and multi-threading. Gosh (git on-chain storage protocol built on TON). Venom blockchain (regulated TVM-based chain). TVM's sharding and asynchronous messaging differs fundamentally from EVM's synchronous call model.

subskills.name: Solana
subskills.description: Solana's architecture differentiators: Proof of History (PoH) as a cryptographic clock enabling parallel transaction ordering, Tower BFT consensus, Sealevel parallel transaction execution, Turbine block propagation, Gulf Stream mempool-less transaction forwarding, Cloudbreak account database. Programs (smart contracts) written in Rust/C/C++ and compiled to BPF. Accounts model vs EVM's storage model. SPL tokens (Solana Program Library). Common developer tools: Anchor framework, Solana CLI, Phantom wallet.

subskills.name: L2 — Arbitrum
subskills.description: Arbitrum as the leading Optimistic Rollup Layer 2 for Ethereum: ArbOS, the Nitro upgrade (WASM-based fraud proofs), Arbitrum One (general purpose), Arbitrum Nova (AnyTrust for gaming/social), Orbit chains (custom L3s). Optimistic Rollup mechanics: transactions batched off-chain, fraud proofs during 7-day challenge window, fast withdrawals via liquidity bridges. EVM-equivalent compatibility means Solidity contracts deploy without modification. Distinctions from zkSync Era and StarkNet (ZK Rollups).

junior.description: Understands the EVM specification and can deploy Solidity contracts on at least one EVM chain; knows chain IDs, RPC endpoints, and the differences in gas/finality between major EVM networks.

mid.description: Deploys on L2s (Arbitrum), has meaningful experience with at least one non-EVM chain (Solana or TVM), and understands cross-chain bridge mechanics and risks.

senior.description: Architects multi-chain systems, evaluates interoperability protocol security trade-offs, and can develop on both EVM and TVM/Solana ecosystems with production experience.
